paper_title: Cosmological bounds on pseudo Nambu-Goldstone bosons
notes: Cosmological bounds (BBN, CMB, Neff, EBL, X-rays, optical) on ALP two-photon coupling g (GeV^-1) vs mass m_phi (eV). The coupling type is clearly AxionPhoton (g_agamma via L = -g/4 F~F phi). However, the limits are presented only as exclusion regions in Figs 1, 2, 6 with no numerical tables or readable digitized values; the only explicit formula given is the low-mass boundary g/GeV^-1 >~ 1e-3 (eV/m_phi)^(3/2) (Eq 3.11). No tabulated (mass, coupling) pairs are extractable. Confidence levels mix 95% and 99% for different bounds. Not a DM haloscope so no local DM density. | read-vote N=3: ct=AxionPhoton (3/3); no consensus curve, took most-points
